result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to an Affiliate or qualifying successor, including through an asset sale; IBM requires Customer consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, and may never assign to a Customer competitor. It adds no change-of-control termination right. The edits are targeted and preserve the original void-assignment and continuing-liability provisions. Drafting is professional, though “successor organization by ... sale of substantially all of its assets” could be phrased more precisely to cover the asset purchaser.
